iti68:1.1: (Tik. II.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti68:2.1: Yassa kassaci bhikkhave rāgo appahīno doso appahīno moho appahīno, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bandho mārassa, {paṭimukk'assa} mārapāso, yathākāmakaraṇīyo ca pāpimato. Yassa kassaci bhikkhave rāgo pahīno doso pahīno moho pahīno, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave abandho mārassa, {omukk'assa} mārapāso, na-yathākāmakaraṇīyo ca pāpimato ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti68:3.1: Yassa rāgo ca doso ca avijjā ca virājitā | taṃ bhāvitattaññataraṃ brahmabhūtaṃ tathāgataṃ | buddhaṃ verabhayātītaṃ āhu sabbapahāyinan-ti ||
iti68:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||9||
